title: Map Component
description: Interactive map component displaying Google Maps for location-based queries

targetURL.description: Google Maps search URL formatted as: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=<URL-encoded-query>

title.description: Optional title for the map panel (e.g., 'Nearby Locations', 'Map View')

searchQuery.description: The search query used to generate the map (for display purposes)
